findings.title: Dead empty class Class1.cs in Infrastructure project
findings.rule_violated: Stub/placeholder with no implementation in production source
findings.remediation: Delete the file. It has no purpose and adds dead weight to the assembly.

findings.title: Near-identical IsTotalOrder and IsValidOrder methods in GraphValidationService
findings.rule_violated: DRY principle — 99% identical code in two methods
findings.remediation: Extract a shared private method (e.g., TryTopologicalSort) returning the order or null on cycle. IsTotalOrder wraps it checking for unique order; IsValidOrder checks for no cycles.

findings.title: Swallowed exception in database restore path
findings.rule_violated: Best practice: never swallow exceptions silently; log full stack trace and notify caller
findings.remediation: At minimum, log ex.ToString() instead of ex.Message. Consider setting an error flag to show user-facing notification rather than continuing with an empty database.

findings.title: Widespread var usage violations against .editorconfig mandate
findings.evidence_snippet:
// ~50+ locations found using explicit types where editorconfig mandates var
string root = uf.Find(entryId);  // should be: var root
int n = allEntryIdsList.Count;   // should be: var n
double sum = nextGamma.Sum();    // should be: var sum
findings.remediation: Run `dotnet format` on the solution to auto-fix all var preferences at once.

findings.title: No sealed classes anywhere in the codebase
findings.rule_violated: CA1852 — Type can be sealed when it has no visible subclasses. JIT cannot devirtualize calls without sealed.
findings.remediation: Add `sealed` to all leaf classes. For DI-registered implementations, sealed enables devirtualization. For entity classes, sealing removes virtual method table overhead.

findings.title: Large methods exceeding 50-line maintainability threshold
findings.evidence_snippet:
ResolveGlobalStrengths: 116 lines, 3-deep nested loops
IsTotalOrder: 85 lines
IsValidOrder: 84 lines
GetSortedTiers: 97 lines
findings.rule_violated: Method length >50 lines degrades readability, testability, and indicates single-responsibility violation
findings.remediation: Extract inner loops into named private methods (e.g., IterateBradleyTerryStep, BuildTopologicalTiers). This also reduces nesting depth.

findings.title: Inefficient client-side join in SqliteEntryRepository queries
findings.rule_violated: CA1822 / query efficiency: O(n*m) client-side match instead of database JOIN
findings.remediation: Add a navigation property from EntryScoreEntity to CategoryEntity and use .Include() for eager loading, or join directly via _context.Categories.Where() in the query.

findings.title: Magic numbers without named constants
findings.evidence_snippet:
if (range < 1e-9)                                     // 2 scoring files
if (iter > 50 && iter % 10 == 0)                       // BradleyTerry:90
if (stable && maxDiff < 1e-3)                          // BradleyTerry:108
findings.rule_violated: Magic numbers obscure intent; use named constants
findings.remediation: Define constants: const double Epsilon = 1e-9; const int RankStabilityCheckStart = 50; const int RankStabilityCheckInterval = 10; const double RankStabilityThreshold = 1e-3;

findings.title: Tuple<string, string> should be ValueTuple (string, string)
findings.rule_violated: Use modern C# ValueTuple structs over reference-type Tuple for performance
findings.remediation: Change to private (string A, string B)? suggestedPair; and assign with suggestedPair = (a, b);

findings.title: Missing sealed on private nested UnionFind class
findings.rule_violated: CA1852 — even private nested types benefit from sealed for JIT devirtualization
